liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Caution** (1 review): Reviewer hears what sounds like a Coltrane 'A Love Supreme' tease about 1:20 into the jam [10]

## The recordings

- **gd67-09-04.sbd.partial.jools.19514.19526.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 2 songs; 6 min; rated 3.5/5 by 10 [1]. Said about its sound: Good sound quality, with a tape splice audible at the start [2]

## Around the show

- Per Phil's book, Mickey sat in with the band for the first time near the end of the show [5]
- Phil recalls Jerry hugging Mickey afterward and saying that this was truly the Grateful Dead [5]
- Reviewer says it is the first show of those heard from 1965 onward with an extended feedback section [8]
- Reviewer hears big growth over eight months, from blues standards with jams toward complex originals of the Anthem of the Sun era [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd67-09-04.sbd.partial.jools.19514.19526.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Julian (Jools) Elliott; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Reel master went to one cassette generation, then DAT, then circulation; only a roughly six-minute fragment of Caution into Feedback survives; Fragment was found on Latvala's cassette of the 9/3/67 show, so the date may be wrong; Jools Elliott uploaded it in 2003; This date and the previous one reportedly made up tapes once labeled 'Russian River '68' [1][4]
